# 784. Letter Case Permutation

## Solution 1 (time O(2^n), space O(n^2))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def letterCasePermutation(self, s):
        """
        :type s: str
        :rtype: List[str]
        """
        n = len(s)
        ans = []

        def dfs(cur_str, i):
            if i == n:
                ans.append(cur_str)
                return
            if s[i].isalpha():
                dfs(cur_str + s[i].lower(), i + 1)
                dfs(cur_str + s[i].lower().upper(), i + 1)
            else:
                dfs(cur_str + s[i], i + 1)

        dfs("", 0)
        return ans
```
